artifact.note: Release build of the source commit above; earlier steps ran on the builds that preceded each fix listed under findings.

host.engine: Docker Desktop 29.6.1, Linux, context desktop-linux, containerd image store

route: Application launched on a hidden desktop with --software-rendering and --open-dockerfile; actions invoked through UI Automation patterns from a process on the same hidden desktop; keys posted to the window as WM_KEYDOWN messages; window captures through PrintWindow.
scope: A three-stage probe Dockerfile with line continuations, built locally to the tag my-image:latest. That image and a second probe image were removed afterwards. Captures are not published because image and container lists also showed unrelated resources on the host.

steps.action: Build: Build with the probe Dockerfile
steps.observed: BuildKit run completed, exit 0; the operation panel shows plain text (no terminal colour codes)
3 stages and 3 links drawn with elbow connectors; stage footers 'cached · from the build at 07:32' and '3.6 MB built image · cached' on the target

steps.action: Canvas: Zoom in three times, focus the minimap, arrow keys
steps.observed: The view moved down and the minimap's outline box followed

steps.action: Canvas: M with the minimap focused
steps.observed: The minimap hid and the toggle switched to Show minimap

steps.action: Images after a rebuild: select my-image:latest, Open full view
steps.observed: The list had reloaded (new image ID); the detail showed 20 history rows with notes 'Base: alpine:3.20', 'Your Dockerfile, line 10 … 15' and 'from stage deps / build'
docker scout recommendations ran (exit 0, 5.7 s): 'No newer base image is recommended. The current base image is up to date. Current base alpine:3.20'

steps.action: Images: open the regular expression builder, toggle Tokens and library
steps.observed: The builder opened centred on the window with three panes; turning the pane off removed it and the pattern pane widened

steps.action: Palette: start from Node.js, then Replace draft
steps.observed: The confirmation appeared in the window and the Creator loaded 3 stages and 14 instructions

steps.action: Creator: select WORKDIR /app in the outline, Next step twice
steps.observed: The open step moved to 'Copy files · Step 4 / 8 · From stage build' and the outline selection followed
Live second lines: Containers '12 running · 25 total' (matching the page), Images '107 images · 86.57 GB'; pages not yet loaded kept their description

steps.action: Settings › Appearance: Compare A/B, then Apply B
steps.observed: B (Default light) was drawn beside the live theme without changing it; Apply B switched the app to the light scheme as one undoable change
Read the real desktop picture (read only): 'Taken from the desktop picture. Seed #B7CBD8.'; the hue, chroma and tone controls moved to 236°, 0.028 and 83

steps.action: Settings › Appearance: Density with the studio at full width
steps.observed: After the fix the shape, density and type row stacks below 880 px, so the density labels are no longer cut

steps.action: Creator: select the named step 'Install dependencies' in the outline, F2, type 'Install npm packages', Enter
steps.observed: The open step title, the outline row and the source line '# step: Install npm packages' all changed, with a confirmation; F2 from the outline needed a fix first

findings: Fixed: a Dockerfile with RUN or ENV continuations made Canvas source-only and the Build editor count 0 stages; continued instructions are now joined for analysis.
Fixed: BuildKit colour codes appeared as '[33m' in the operation panel; output is reduced to plain text.
Fixed: docker output was decoded with the console code page, so Scout's box drawing showed as 'â”‚'; output is now read as UTF-8.
Fixed: tab page content was missing from UI Automation (screen readers saw only tab headers) because the tab template did not name PART_SelectedContentHost.
Fixed: the Canvas minimap had no automation peer, and M did nothing while the minimap had focus.
Fixed: an off-screen page kept its list after a build, so a rebuilt image opened as 'No such image'; hidden pages reload after any operation and the image detail falls back to the tag.
Fixed: the Appearance studio's Density segments were cut to 'Compa…'; the shape, density and type row now stacks below 880 px.
Not a defect: one capture showed a black band at the bottom; an immediate recapture was complete (paint race of the hidden-desktop capture).
Fixed: F2 on an outline row did nothing; it now renames that step.
Fixed: suggestion documentation inherited the editor's monospace font; prose now uses the body font.

Fixed: Creator quick-add chips and step hints were English in Cantonese (the chips were created untranslated, hints are composed 'A · B' and needed phrase-by-phrase translation); a check now covers every starter hint and starter name.

Changed: the suggestions popup is placed through WPF's custom placement with its real size, so it stays inside the window; a capture-time log confirmed the card at 672-1432 px of a 1440 px window. Offscreen captures can still show it outside because the capture window is wider than the monitor's work area there.
notExercised: Pointer click and drag on the minimap: background mouse messages posted to a window on a hidden desktop do not reach WPF (it reads the real cursor), and a foreground drag would need the visible desktop, which is not used for these runs. Keyboard panning, the toggle and the M key were driven; the click-to-position maths has checks in tests/UiState (CanvasRoutingChecks).
Visible transition and spring animations were not timed; their plans have rule checks (AppearanceMotionChecks).
note: The host's application data folder was backed up before each run and restored from the pre-session backup afterwards (settings.json SHA-256 equal to the backup). The probe images were removed.
